description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Ihala Thabbowa, Naththandiya D/S Division, Puttalam District (25/1200073)
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" under the Registration of Title Act, dealing specifically with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, and land title determinations for various parcels in Puttalam and Galle districts. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership claims, and land title settlement matters.
